inputs.name: machine_id
inputs.description: Dryer (DRY-A/B/C), press (PRS-1/2), expeller (EXP-1/2) or centrifuge (CFG-1); DRY-C retired 2019-06, DRY-B commissioned 2019-07

inputs.name: crew_team
inputs.description: Rotating crew A/B/C

inputs.name: product_specific_feed_kg
inputs.description: Product-specific feed (SRS §5.4 denominator): DC = pared white kernel; CM = separated white kernel; VCO cold press = dried kernel (DK); VCO wet = fresh white kernel

inputs.name: source_region
inputs.description: Coconut-triangle district the lot was bought from

inputs.name: nuts_received
inputs.description: Nuts in the received lot

inputs.name: nut_storage_days
inputs.description: Seasoning/storage days of nuts before processing

inputs.name: immature_nut_pct
inputs.description: Immature nuts found in lot QC sample

inputs.name: germinated_nut_pct
inputs.description: Germinated nuts found in lot QC sample

inputs.name: avg_dehusked_nut_weight_g
inputs.description: Mean de-husked nut weight in lot sample (occasionally not recorded)

inputs.name: lab_kernel_moisture_pct
inputs.description: Kernel moisture, oven method, lot composite sample

inputs.name: lab_kernel_fat_pct_wb
inputs.description: Kernel fat, Soxhlet, lot composite sample (missing when lab backlog)

inputs.name: paring_loss_pct
inputs.description: Paring loss as % of whole kernel

inputs.name: days_since_maintenance
inputs.description: Days since last preventive maintenance of the machine

inputs.name: machine_age_years
inputs.description: Years since machine commissioning

inputs.name: planned_dryer_inlet_temp_c
inputs.description: DC: planned hot-air inlet temperature; VCO cold press: planned kernel-drying temperature (<=60 C)

inputs.name: planned_dryer_residence_min
inputs.description: Planned dryer residence time

inputs.name: pack_format
inputs.description: Packing format

inputs.name: feed_moisture_pct
inputs.description: Dried-kernel moisture before expelling (measured)

inputs.name: kernel_to_dryer_delay_h
inputs.description: Hours between grating and start of drying

inputs.name: planned_expeller_passes
inputs.description: 1 or 2 expeller passes

inputs.name: planned_feed_rate_kg_h
inputs.description: Planned expeller feed rate

inputs.name: ambient_temp_c
inputs.description: Daily mean air temperature at factory (Kurunegala)

inputs.name: ambient_rh_pct
inputs.description: Daily mean relative humidity at factory

inputs.name: rain_today_mm
inputs.description: Daily rainfall at factory

inputs.name: rain_7d_mm
inputs.description: Rainfall of the previous 7 days at factory

inputs.name: scheduled_power_cut_h
inputs.description: Published CEB/PUCSL load-shedding hours for the day

inputs.name: power_cut_scheduled
inputs.description: 1 if any scheduled power cut

inputs.name: national_coconut_prod_mn_nuts_lag2m
inputs.description: National coconut production two months earlier (latest published)

inputs.name: retail_nut_price_lkr_lag1m
inputs.description: Average retail coconut price previous month

inputs.name: event_context
inputs.description: Operational event in force (curfew, COVID, power crisis, flood, cyclone)
categories: COVID-19 curfew - export industries operating on permits
COVID-19 second wave - Gampaha (Minuwangoda) cluster curfews
COVID-19 third wave - island-wide travel restrictions
Fuel issuance halted for non-essential services
Power cuts ~2.5-3 h/day; QR fuel pass

inputs.name: is_poya_day
inputs.description: Full-moon Poya day

inputs.name: month
inputs.description: Calendar month

inputs.name: day_of_week
inputs.description: Day of week

inputs.name: monsoon_season
inputs.description: SW monsoon (May-Sep), NE monsoon (Dec-Feb), inter-monsoon

inputs.name: hist_yield_mean_30d_variant
inputs.description: Mean saleable yield of same model group+variant over the previous 30 days (strictly earlier dates)

inputs.name: hist_yield_mean_90d_variant
inputs.description: As above, previous 90 days

inputs.name: hist_yield_mean_30d_machine
inputs.description: Mean saleable yield of the same machine over previous 30 days
